summary: Thursday market update: DraftKings anytime-touchdown prices are now visible for Lions-Bills, but no player line has cleared the projection, injury and price-value checks for an official Hot Pick.
takeaways: Detroit-Buffalo is still a high-total environment, but popular anytime-touchdown availability is not evidence of value. Jahmyr Gibbs at -320 and James Cook at -170 require very high break-even probabilities.

Detroit listed guard Christian Mahogany and tackle Blake Miller as non-participants on both Monday and Tuesday estimates. Wednesday participation and game statuses remain necessary before locking Detroit workload assumptions.

The first visible fun-market screen includes Amon-Ra St. Brown +105, Dalton Kincaid +180, Jameson Williams +205 and Khalil Shakir +215 to score. They remain watch items until touchdown opportunity, role and fair-price estimates are verified.
watch: Lions @ Bills ATTD menu — DraftKings Network showed Gibbs -320, Cook -170, Josh Allen -135, Amon-Ra St. Brown +105, Kincaid +180, Jameson Williams +205 and Shakir +215 at the Sep 16 morning check. These are available prices, not recommendations.
Detroit offensive line — Mahogany and Miller were DNP on the first two estimated reports. Recheck the official Wednesday report before promoting Detroit rushing, passing or touchdown markets.
